ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark grey to black) across >95% of the visible ventral area; minimal high-intensity (white) pixel distribution restricted to stochastic focal spots and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary field is a solid low-intensity mask; distinct high-contrast pixel clusters are mapped to the distal tips of both lobes; sparse focal points (mottling) are visible in the lower-medial quadrants of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; calculated interior pixel angle approximately 45 degrees; vertical notch depth is significant relative to the central lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing boundary; prominent primary peaks located at the mid-section of both lobes; pixel-amplitude of peaks increases towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral concave sweep from the median notch transitioning to a pronounced upward convexity at the distal 25% of the lobe span.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, rugose pixel clusters localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with localized barnacle colonization; several isolated circular white spots detected in the lower-left lobe region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, faint, low-contrast linear pixel disruption on the right lobe, oriented diagonally from the upper-middle quadrant towards the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant alteration of the geometric lobe boundary at the tips due to dense calcified accretions; multiple small circular depigmentation marks scattered on the ventral surface of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme 'winged' or irregular morphology of the distal tips due to the concentration of acquired anomalies is the most distinct visual marker.
